metadata.description: IDE-first harness: install from GitHub, run /harness-init (no npm package, no terminal CLI).

plugins.name: harness-coding-protocol
plugins.description: Clone or reference this repo as a Claude plugin. /harness-init grounds itself by reading repo files; the IDE_Agent reads, judges, and writes root-truth files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, steering/, Cursor adapters) after one user confirmation. No Node/npm/npx prerequisite for users.
